acceptance: Publish p50/p95 and memory/event-volume measurements for cold, warm, batched and immediate-fallback paths with explicit sample sizes.
Use bounded synthetic ledgers at multiple sizes and declare budgets before optimizing; report setup and projection costs separately.
Reduce demonstrated bottlenecks while preserving durable capture, retries, causal merges, corruption detection and branch isolation.
Keep default agent context bounded and add no model or remote API dependency to routine recording.
payload.description:
Measured cost and scale gap. QA baseline: DIP v0.3.2, 6 October 2026.

The v0.3.2 fallback benchmark measured 150.88 ms paired added blocking median on one Windows machine. It is not a latency guarantee; cold/warm, daemon-backed and large-ledger performance have not been comprehensively characterized.

Evidence and starting points: docs/benchmarks/README.md, src/core.js, src/automation.js.

This is unassigned contributor backlog, not implemented work. Preserve the existing license, DCO and local/offline defaults.
payload.title: DIP-L08: Validate large-ledger performance and reduce measured capture overhead
